items.content:
Super Creative's hero-collector RPG, Epic Seven, is hosting the "Rite of Eternal Inheritance" at the U-PLEX in Hyundai Department Store Sinchon Branch to celebrate its 8th anniversary.

This offline event consists of two parts: a player-and-developer meetup for 160 invited users, and a collaboration cafe open for a month from today (August 29) to September 30. The collab cafe features themed menu items and merchandise centered around the key figures of the 1st World in the Epic Seven universe—including Lisette, the alter ego of Goddess Diche introduced in the 8th anniversary update on the 27th, Kayron before becoming an Apostle, and Uncharted Pioneer Politis, who arrived on Orbis. Producer Tak Kwang-jin and Development Director Heo Dae-kyun were also present at the site, preparing themselves to engage directly with players.

Having firmly taken root over the past eight years since its launch in August 2018, Epic Seven's 8th anniversary event comes alive in these photos from the scene.

items.title: Producer Kwang-jin Tak: "For Epic Seven's 8th anniversary, we prepared with the mindset that we must adapt to survive"
items.summary: ©INVENToday (29th), Super Creative held "Succession of Eternity," an event celebrating the 8th anniversary of its hero collector turn-based RPG Epic Seven, at Hyundai Department Store Sinchon U-PLEX.
items.content:
Today (29th), Super Creative held "Succession of Eternity," an event celebrating the 8th anniversary of its hero collector turn-based RPG Epic Seven, at Hyundai Department Store Sinchon U-PLEX. The 8th anniversary celebration featured a variety of programs for players, including a meetup between developer personnel and pre-invited players, as well as a month-long collaboration cafe.

Ahead of Succession of Eternity, the 8th-anniversary update released on August 27 introduced an offline Battle Delegation mode that allows farming even when the game is closed, story content for the First Era—the original Epic Seven world prior to Ras—and "Call of Chaos," a new mode that streamlines real-time PvP into a more casual experience while adding roguelike elements. Additionally, several upcoming changes were teased, including a Chaos Zero Nightmare collaboration in September, the addition of a permanent roguelike PvE mode called "Dimensional Exploration," and a Steam launch in the second half of this year.

As Epic Seven moves forward by gradually stepping away from elements it had previously adhered to, what is its ultimate direction? Prior to the meetup with players, we spoke with Producer Kwang-jin Tak and Development Director Dae-gyun Huh at the venue.

Q. Epic Seven has reached its 8th anniversary. How do you feel? Also, it has been a very long time since you held a user and media event—is there a special reason for this?

PD Kwang-jin Tak: Thank you for coming today. Under the excuse of developing and servicing the game, we haven't had many opportunities to speak with you directly. Realizing that this was an area where we fell short, we organized this gathering with the media and players for the first time in a long while. Moving forward, we will make sure to meet more often with good news.

Honestly, the 8th anniversary doesn't quite feel real yet. When we first started, I never imagined what the 8th anniversary would look like, and I believe getting to this point is entirely thanks to the support of our players. Because of that, we were able to try many new things. Reaching the 8th anniversary was never our end goal; we see it as a step in moving further forward. Today's event is an extension of that journey.

DD Dae-gyun Huh: Epic Seven has continued to host anniversary events, and we are deeply grateful for the immense interest shown every time. There is plenty of positive feedback as well as constructive criticism, but we view all of it as care and affection for the game, and we intend to listen closely and make improvements. We hope everyone enjoys the event, and today especially, we hope it becomes an occasion where everyone can smile and have fun.

Q. With Epic Seven turning 8, what do you think is the biggest change over the past 8 years from the development team's perspective? Also, what core value do you aim to preserve throughout its service?

PD Kwang-jin Tak: The biggest change is how the development team perceives Epic Seven. Early in service, there were many shortcomings, so we focused on polishing and completing the game. Now that it is on a solid track, we are looking for ways to introduce changes while respecting the play experience that players have built over time.

The value we have sought to protect from the very beginning to now is, naturally, charming characters and high animation quality. We view the fun of turn-based strategy stemming from combinations of Heroes and gear as Epic Seven's identity, and we have constantly contemplated ways to reinforce it.

Q. As you look toward the 10th anniversary, what is your vision for continuing to receive players' love for another 10 years?

PD Kwang-jin Tak: To last for more than 10 or 20 years, we believe even higher quality is needed. This applies to both art quality and content quality. Rather than releasing content frequently, we think it is crucial to craft it properly before presenting it to players. We want to respect the gameplay experience players have had so far while introducing new content distinct from existing modes.

DD Dae-gyun Huh: Epic Seven is often called a "salmon game" because many players step away for a while and return during specific updates. This shows a solid core player base already exists, and we believe the service can only be maintained long-term if this core player base and new players integrate well. Therefore, we pay close attention to narrowing the gap between different player demographics.

Analyzing data shows that player preferences vary greatly. There are core World Arena PvP players, but also quite a few who avoid PvP and enjoy PvE. Some players don't engage heavily in the content itself, yet consistently participate whenever a new character is released. We recognize these diverse player playstyles, and rather than forcing them into a single mold, we are thinking about updates that allow as many players as possible to be satisfied in their own ways.

Epic Seven's 8th Anniversary Update: Everything Revealed
items.summary: Epic Seven's 8th anniversary showcase revealed a new episode, a roguelike mode, a Chaos Zero Nightmare collab, a Steam launch, and much more.
items.content:
Gaming Epic Seven's 8th Anniversary Update: Everything Revealed GameDaily Follow Franz Christian Irorita Mon, August 24, 2026 at 7:30 PM UTC Mon, August 24, 2026 at 7:30 PM UTC Epic Seven 's 8th Anniversary Infinity Showcase brought a genuinely large wave of announcements, from a new story episode and heroes to a Steam launch and a major crossover collaboration. Here's everything that has been revealed.

The anniversary showcase revealed a new Side Episode, Paradise Lost, set in the 1st World, the earliest setting in the Epic Seven universe.

Two new heroes join alongside it: Lisette, the alter ego of Goddess Diche, a Light-elemental Soul Weaver built around reviving and restoring allies, and Uncharted Pioneer Politis, introduced at the moment of her first landing on Orbis in the 1st World, whose role shifts depending on where she's placed on the team.

Acolyte of the End Kayron will factor heavily into Paradise Lost's story and gets a separate, dedicated introduction later, while a character named Kain will appear as a playable NPC rather than a summonable hero.

Background Battling now keeps running even after the game is closed, with players able to register up to 100 Leif, roughly 400 runs, and duration now calculated against a player's actual clear records rather than a flat estimate. New auto-sell and auto-extract options for Equipment are coming alongside it.

An Equipment Charm Payback Event starts August 27 and runs three weeks, returning a set percentage of invested EXP as Greater Charm Selection Chests. Ogre's Armory is being folded into the Hunt menu as new content called Ogre Hunt, available at Otherworld Difficulty and offering Reversal, Riposte, Warfare, and Pursuit Sets.

Rift is being temporarily suspended starting August 27 for content restructuring. Profile Cards are also getting a refresh, with layers increasing from 100 to 130, saved slots doubling from 5 to 10, and new colors, shapes, emoji placement, direct coordinate input, PC shortcuts, and a gift-to-friend option added.

A new World Arena mode called The Call of Chaos brings 3v3 arcade-style PvP with a fast pick-ban phase, roughly a minute long with up to three rerolls, followed immediately by combat.

The goal is to destroy the opponent's Sentinel, with players able to trigger various ally buffs or enemy debuffs by choosing a "Fate" mid-battle. Runs end at 7 wins or 3 losses, with better rewards for more wins, and players earn Ranking Points and shop currency along the way, with season-based ranking rewards on top.

Super Creative is bringing its other major title into Epic Seven this September, crossing over with Chaos Zero Nightmare .

Renoa arrives as a free character during the collaboration period, while Haru and Mei Lin will be available through Limited Summon. Several collaboration events, including a Counseling Center and dedicated shop, will run in Witchaven for the duration.

It's a natural pairing for Super Creative, which has been actively cross-promoting CZN alongside its other titles at events like Anime Expo 2026 as the newer, darker-toned game builds its own audience.

Epic Seven 's first official roguelike mode, Dimensional Exploration, launches with unlimited attempts and no entry currency required.

Players form a 3-Hero team, choose special effects through Expedition Supplies, and can assign up to three additional heroes to tag slots to swap in mid-battle, for up to seven usable heroes total.

items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ “Secret Summer” Update Live—New Limited Hero, Story, “Epic Dash” Event
items.summary: This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate have launched their latest summer update to their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game
items.content:
This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate have launched their latest summer update to their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’ across PC and mobile platforms. This seasonal update includes a new Limited Hero, a Special Side Story, and the latest “Epic Dash” event. A special summer coupon code, “E7SUMMERGIFT26”, is also available for redemption until 26 August—you can redeem it in-game or by clicking over here .

The Limited Hero introduced for the 2026 summer season is Eye of the Abyss Fumyr. As a central figure in the newly added Special Side Story, “Show Me What Lies Within,” she visits the Aelo Coast to track the whereabouts of Harsetti, the sovran of Shadow Elves, only to find herself swept up in a series of unexpected incidents.

Eye of the Abyss Fumyr is a 5★ Earth Elemental Mage obtainable until July 16. Her Skill 3, “Eye of the Abyss,” inflicts “Detain” on the foremost enemy Hero, temporarily removing them from the battlefield. This allows players to collapse the enemy’s frontline and drive the battle to their advantage.

Story starring Fumyr will run for six weeks until 6 August. Set against a coastal backdrop, the narrative features a diverse cast of characters alongside Fumyr, including the information broker “Birgitta” and her assistant “Aube.” Notably, as players progress through the story, they can play a classic “territory-capture” style arcade mini game to acquire various rewards, including high-quality illustrations.

Meanwhile, the “Epic Dash” event will take place from June 25 to August 27, offering massive benefits for Hero acquisition and growth. Players can clear daily and weekly missions to level up their “Mission Pass” rank and claim rewards. Depending on their rank, players can obtain a 5★ Hero Selector that provides a Hero with all progression fully completed, a 5★ Limited Hero Selector, a standard 5★ Hero Selector, various Summon Currencies, Equipment Sets, and more.

Also, as part of the Epic Dash lineup, the “Premium Moonlight Summon” event will grant players up to 100 free Moonlight Hero summons simply by logging in daily. As an extra milestone bonus, players will receive a 5★ Light Elemental Hero Summon Ticket upon performing 20 summons, and a 5★ Dark Elemental Hero Summon Ticket upon performing 100 summons. Finally, the update brings the “Lucky Dash” event, where players can obtain various Equipment and Charms, alongside the “Epic Dash Buff” event, which provides several powerful in-game buffs.

The developer has also prepared a set of “Secret Summer Digital Merchandise” featuring wallpapers of some of Epic Seven’s heroines. You can download the images from the game’s official website (bottom of the page) to grab copies tailor-made for your PC, mobile, tablet, and watch.

Epic Seven is available as a free-to-play title across PC via STOVE , iOS , and Android via Google Play .

items.title: Epic Seven Releases New Shepherd of the Dark Diene Update
items.summary: Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update
items.content:
Posted in: Games , Mobile Games , Video Games | Tagged: Epic Seven , Smilegate , Super Creative

Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update

Smilegate and developer Super Creative has launched a new update for Epic Seven , bringing with it a new character. Players now have access to Shepherd of the Dark Diene, a new Moonlight Hero who brings a different set of attacks and more to the fray, along with a New Year's event to kick off 2026. We have more details here as the content is live today.

Shepherd of the Dark Diene is a country girl who, after encountering a black wolf in the forest, forms a contract with Noias, the Dark Spirit Lord, who has appeared for the first time in centuries. Driven by her admiration for the Hero "Aki" and her unwavering determination, she embarks on her journey to save the world. But as her journey unfolds, it begins to transform into something dark and twisted. She is a 5★ Dark elemental Mage Hero who can lead battles to her advantage by utilizing various effects that trigger when she is granted "immortality." Her Skill 1, "Crimson Claws," inflicts rupture on the enemy, and a successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportionally to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, it triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

Her Skill 2, "Noias's Guidance," grants immortality for 1 turn at the start of battle. Additionally, when someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating "Dark Moon," which dispels buffs from all enemies, grants immortality to the caster for 3 turns, and increases Combat Readiness by 35%. Her Skill 3, "Endless Darkness," inflicts seal on all enemies for 2 turns, and attacks them before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Also, a successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, they ignore Effect Resistance.

To celebrate the New Year, Smilegate will also be running several in-game events. First, the "New Year Check-In Event" will run for three weeks until the 22nd. Players can log in to receive a New Year's greeting from Merurin. The New Year's Gift Chest includes Lv. 88 Equipment and "Fire Horse Stamps," which can be used in concurrent events. The second event, "Collect New Year Stamps," will run during the same period. By consuming Energy daily, players can obtain "Leif" and the event currency, "Fire Horse Stamps." In the third event, "New Year's Gift Arrived!," players can use the "Fire Horse Stamps" earned from the two events mentioned earlier to open random chests containing rewards such as MolaGora and Charms. Finally, in the "Merurin's Lucky Pouch" event, players can clear simple missions to earn various rewards, including a final reward of 1,000 Skystone.
